name: AsiaPhos Limited
summary: AsiaPhos Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures, sells, and trades in phosphate-based chemical products in the People's Republic of China, Singapore, India, the United States, and internationally. The company offers yellow phosphorus, sodium tripolyphosphate, sodium trimetaphosphate, sodium hexametaphosphate, trisodium phosphate, tetra-sodium pyrophosphate, tetrapotassium pyrophosphate, sodium acid pyrophosphate, disodium phosphate, monosodium phosphate, and Phosphoric Acid. It is also involved in the general wholesale trade and trading of chemicals; and provision of Internet technology consulting and transportation services. AsiaPhos Limited was founded in 1996 and is based in Singapore.
